rules: A detection requires an E1-or-higher binding finding with the expected pattern and a source location matching the frozen regex. A verdict alone, a finding without location, or an unrelated warning cannot detect.
On a vulnerable case, a completed applicable run without such a finding is MISS. A safe/clean certification on that case is also counted separately as unsafe certification.

On a repaired or legitimate case, an applicable binding warning at the expected pattern/location is FALSE-ALARM. A completed run with no such warning is CLEAR; unrelated warnings are retained in a non-target column, not called false alarms.
PENDING labels, missing triples, unsupported frontends, missing tools, timeout, failed setup, and integration-UNKNOWN are UNKNOWN, never wins or misses.
A tool crash after valid setup is ERROR. A source/build/setup failure is UNKNOWN with reason, not ERROR.
A circuit-only result does not certify a circuit-contract binding; its integration status is UNKNOWN.
HUMAN-ACCEPTED, AI-PROPOSED, and PENDING are reported separately; no headline denominator draws from AI-PROPOSED or PENDING.
excluded_reason: The synthetic Foundry harness substitutes an always-true verifier and has no binding-location evidence.
